title: 阿狸 · 九尾饼干时光
description: 狐耳阿狸穿奶油色毛衣，坐在矮桌边递出星形饼干，蓬松白尾围在身后。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayons with broken edges, scribbled fill and visible warm paper tooth
art_direction.palette: cream paper, cherry red, warm tan, blush pink, tiny sky-blue accents
art_direction.composition: Ahri, the recognizable fox-eared adult woman from League of Legends, in an original cozy everyday costume: cream long-sleeve sweater, simple red skirt over opaque leggings, rounded slippers. Long dark hair, warm amber eyes, subtle three whisker marks on each cheek, upright dark fox ears. Nine fluffy white fox tails fan behind her like a soft cloud, with distinct rounded tail shapes clearly attached behind the body. She sits sideways on a floor cushion beside a low wooden tea table, delightfully offering one star-shaped cookie on a small saucer toward the viewer. A tiny pale blue magic orb floats gently above the table as a secondary friendly light, not an attack. One cup and a modest plate, no crowd. Cheerful, welcoming, slightly tilted head; all tails and ears remain inside the square. Paper-cream, cherry red and warm biscuit colors, a touch of blue.

visual_qa.method: six-image compressed JPEG contact sheet review, 1280x900
